findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the incorrect rendering of "songbird" and the awkward rendering of "the rumble of thunder" with idiomatic Swahili that preserves the original meaning. For example: change "ndege mchungaji akimtukuza Muumba wake, radi taratibu, au patapaka ya mvua juu ya paa." to "ndege wa wimbo ikimtukuza Muumba wake, mlio la radi, au patapaka rahisi ya mvua juu ya paa." tag is modified and keep all HTML tags and attributes unchanged.
